name: jvd-frontend
description: Shared setup for the React/Vite side of the JVD-Soft stack: a scaffolder that brings a project up to the baseline, a read guard that keeps build output out of context, format-on-edit, and the review, accessibility, testing and prerender agents both projects use.

APP_NAME.description: Product name. Goes into <title>, the PWA manifest, og:site_name and every schema.org block.

APP_SHORT_NAME.description: Home-screen label. Around 12 characters — longer is truncated by the launcher, not wrapped.

APP_DESCRIPTION.description: One sentence. It is the fallback meta description and the manifest description, so write it for a search result.

SITE_URL.description: Absolute public origin, no trailing slash. Canonical URLs, og:url and sitemap.xml are ignored by crawlers unless absolute.

LANG.description: Default document language, as a BCP 47 tag. Sets <html lang> and the manifest's lang.

THEME_COLOR_LIGHT.description: Browser UI colour in light mode, and the PWA splash background.

THEME_COLOR_DARK.description: Browser UI colour in dark mode.

PWA_CATEGORIES.description: Manifest categories as a JSON array literal, e.g. ["productivity","business"]. Substituted into vite.config.ts as written, so it must be valid JSON.
